corrections.after: Independent audit. A separate reviewer extracted the 33 modules from a sealed archive, matched their hashes, and compiled and kernel-checked all of them from an empty build. The reviewer read every module and found no sorry, added axiom, unsafe code or metaprogramming, and no hypothesis carrying the conclusion. A walk of the 6913 constants in the transitive closure of the endpoint found only the three axioms above and no unsafe or partial constant. The statement was compared with Hollom's definitions and the MathDB record. Lean control modules confirm the exact counts 1 and 2 at n = 1, the counts 7 and 9 out of 16 for a case at n = 2, that the reversed inequality is false for some instance, and that both vertical directions share one token. Four cosmetic or low-severity defects were reported, none affecting validity or fidelity. The relabeling of an abstract transitive tournament to the vertex set {0,...,n-1} is not formalized and is trivial. Upstream Lean and mathlib were trusted rather than rebuilt, and the mathlib checkout was confirmed to be at the stated revision. The reviewer was an AI system distinct from those that produced the proof, and this is not a human referee report.
